Emraan Hashmi became 'Batman' to get his cancer-stricken son to eat during chemotherapy, old video of actor resurfaces as he recalls the toughest days in hospital: "It's not easy for a child to undergo chemotherapy"
articles.description: Emraan Hashmi's son, Ayaan, faced an incredible fight against Wilms' tumour, a rare form of childhood kidney cancer. The path to recovery involved a tough regimen of surgery and chemotherapy. To uplift Ayaan's spirits, his father brought a sense of fun by dressing up as Batman, encouraging him to eat with playful imagination. Five years later, Ayaan triumphed over his battle, emerging cancer-free.

articles.title: Google’s India-first AI models for agriculture are finding applications beyond India
articles.description: Google's agricultural AI models, developed in India, have expanded their reach to eleven countries, facilitating advancements in farming and water management systems. By harnessing satellite imagery, these models support sustainable practices, such as rice cultivation and informed agricultural financing. State governments are now incorporating this innovative technology into their digital agriculture platforms, ultimately enhancing global food security through improved data access.

articles.title: Dolly Parton’s humble Tennessee childhood cabin inspired her journey
articles.description: Dolly Parton grew up with 11 siblings in a tiny two-room Tennessee cabin without electricity or running water. The humble home remained close to her heart and inspired her music and life. In 1986, she recreated the family cabin at Dollywood, offering visitors a glimpse into the modest surroundings that shaped her extraordinary journey.

This enchanting performance, highlighting themes of acceptance and unity, has stood the test of time, capturing the hearts of fans well into the future and leaving a lasting legacy in television history.

articles.title: How a 3-word phrase Travis Kelce said on his podcast unlocked a $100 million licensing deal
articles.description: Originating from the Kelce brothers' podcast, the term "92%ers" has sparked a phenomenon, transforming loyal listeners into a cultural movement. The momentum generated not only facilitated a major deal with Wondery, securing worldwide merchandise and advertising rights but also increased the podcast's appeal immensely. This comprehensive agreement, covering past content for profit, now allows Travis Kelce to earn even more than his football salary.

articles.title: From small roles to Masaan: Mukesh Chhabra recalls casting Vicky Kaushal
articles.description: Casting director Mukesh Chhabra disclosed that a last-minute alteration led to Vicky Kaushal landing the role in Masaan. A well-known actor unexpectedly left the project just a week before the casting process was set to close. After viewing Kaushal's audition tape, Chhabra and Anurag Kashyap made the daring choice to cast him. Initially met with skepticism regarding his fit for the lead, Kaushal's performance ultimately earned him significant praise.

articles.title: Juhi Mui creator Dhruv R Jain: Television is not going through an identity crisis

He also addresses comparisons between Juhi Mui and Extraordinary Attorney Woo, explaining the show’s approach to originality and authenticity while portraying its protagonist on the autism spectrum, and the research undertaken to ensure a nuanced representation.

articles.title: At 4, a Japanese girl became fascinated by female DJs on YouTube. By 6, she was performing to packed crowds with a Guinness World Record

Inspired by female DJs she watched on YouTube, she began learning the craft at 5 and has since performed for large crowds, at music events and alongside experienced DJs. Now 7, she continues to balance her growing DJ career with school and her everyday childhood interests.v

articles.title: In 1968, two Russian steppe tortoises travelled around the Moon before humans did. They survived a punishing 20G force while returning to Earth
articles.description: In a remarkable journey, two Russian steppe tortoises embarked on a mission aboard Zond 5, orbiting the Moon in September 1968. This pioneering endeavour demonstrated that biological life could endure the challenges of circumlunar spaceflight and successfully return. Despite facing intense gravitational stress during re-entry, the resilient tortoises emerged unscathed, making their voyage a historic precursor to mankind's lunar exploration.

articles.title: Bhagwat Vs Mamdani: ‘Oneness’ Meets ‘Exclusionary Vision’ | Big Clash In New York | Newshour
articles.description: In this episode of Newshour Debate, anchor Navika Kumar discusses the political controversy surrounding RSS chief Mohan Bhagwat’s visit to New York and his message of “Oneness.” The visit has drawn criticism from Zohran Mamdani, who has described the RSS vision as exclusionary. The BJP has hit back, accusing Mamdani of holding a “biased and distorted” view while questioning what it calls selective opposition to certain ideologies and organisations. The debate raises a larger question, is the discourse on inclusion being applied selectively?#mohanbhagwat #bhagwat #rss #zohranmamdani #mamdani #newyork #oneness #bjp #indianpolitics #navikakumar #newshour #timesnow #englishnews

Following the mixed reviews of their recent release, Batwara 1947, Santoshi expressed his disappointment over the lukewarm reception. With their latest project, he aims to reignite the magic of their previous successes and captivate viewers once again.
